requirements.title: Pointer association status is associated, disassociated, or undefined with specified initialization states
requirements.definition: A pointer has association status associated, disassociated, or undefined; status may change during execution. Unless initialized explicitly or by default, initial status is undefined. A pointer may be initialized disassociated or associated.

pending.association-status-three-states: PENDING after batch286: this facet includes undefined association status, which has no portable positive runtime oracle; associated and disassociated changes are covered by separate facets.
pending.uninitialized-pointer-status-undefined-n: PENDING after batch286: ASSOCIATED or dereference of an uninitialized pointer would be nonconforming; fixtures initialize status before inquiry.

requirements.oracle:
Source registration only. Future fixtures establish a distinguished non-default state first, then observe only portable single-image properties: exact integer, logical, character, type, rank, bounds, ASSOCIATED inquiry results for defined pointer association status, or required syntax diagnostics owned by a numbered rule. Undefined pointer association status and undefined definition status are never inspected, dereferenced, invoked, compared, or passed to ASSOCIATED as an oracle.

S19.5.2.2-001 pointer-association runtime fixtures: one program checks explicit NULL() initialization yields ASSOCIATED false, non-NULL pointer initialization yields ASSOCIATED true with the initialized target, and a runtime pointer changes from associated to disassociated to associated with another target. Feature mutants replace NULL() initialization, redirect non-NULL initialization, or remove the NULLIFY event.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Unnumbered program restrictions are source-control restrictions only. Notes are informative. Coarray, image, team, companion-processor lifetime, volatile-interference, addresses, diagnostic wording, exit status details, and processor-dependent representations are not asserted.

S19.5.2.2-001 pointer-association fixture boundaries: only single-image defined association statuses, exact integer values, character length/equality, bounds inquiries, and SELECT TYPE reachability are asserted. Undefined pointer association status and undefined definition status are not inspected, passed to ASSOCIATED, dereferenced, compared, or used as diagnostic oracles. Coarray/different-image, companion-processor lifetime, VOLATILE interference, storage/inheritance-association owners, addresses, finalization, and processor-dependent diagnostics remain outside this packet.
